layout.arrangement: No slide title. A thin red rectangular frame outlines the entire content area (roughly 6%–94% of slide width, 7%–91% of slide height). Inside it, four activation-function panels are arranged in a 2×2 grid: top-left (ReLU), top-right (Parametric ReLU), bottom-left (Exponential LU), bottom-right (SoftPlus). Each panel consists of a rounded, light-pink formula box with a red border on top and a blue-bordered graph box directly beneath it. A yellow circular slide-number badge ('21') sits inside the red frame at the extreme top-right, to the right of the top-right panel. A solid black horizontal bar (letterbox) runs along the very bottom edge of the image.

Four small mathematical line plots (ReLU, Parametric ReLU, Exponential LU, Softplus) drawn as red curves on light-gray grids inside blue/indigo rectangular frames.
Four rounded light-pink formula callout boxes with thin red borders containing colored serif mathematics.
typography_notes: Formulas are set in a serif math face (Times/Computer-Modern-like) at roughly 16–18 pt, with 'F(x) =' in black, function names in red (with 'Re' of 'Rectified' in bold red, and 'P'/'E' of 'Parametric'/'Exponential' in bold blue), case values in red or blue, and the conditions 'for x < 0' / 'for x ≥ 0' in bold italic (black for the first case, green for the second). 'SoftPlus' is bold red; 'log' is black with a subscript 'e'. Graph tick labels, axis labels and the legend are small sans-serif (~7–8 pt) in black; the legend uses the Greek alpha. No bullet lists, no all-caps headings, no slide title.
animation_state: No obvious mid-build state: all four formula boxes and all four graphs are fully visible simultaneously. The only ambiguous element is the solid red filled circle used as the x < 0 case value in the Parametric ReLU formula, which may be a redacted, covered, or animated symbol rather than a legible character.

7. Bottom-left formula box (x 10–45%, y 49–59%): same pink/red rounded style. Text: 'F(x) = ' black, 'E' bold blue, 'xponential LU' red, ' = ' black, red curly brace, row 1: 'α (e^x − 1)' in blue (#0000CC) with superscript x + ' for x < 0' in black bold italic; row 2: 'x' in red + ' for x ≥ 0' in green bold italic.
8. Bottom-left graph (x 12–42%, y 60–89%): white rectangle, #3333CC border, #D9D9D9 grid. Rotated y-axis label 'f(x, α)' on the left; x-axis label 'x' below the axis. Y ticks: 3, 2, 1, −1. Curves: red α = 1.0 starts near (−3, −0.95) approaching the −1 asymptote, passes through (0,0), then follows y = x to (3,3); blue, orange and green curves nearly flat at ≈ −0.1, ≈ −0.2, ≈ −0.5 respectively for x < 0, merging with y = x for x ≥ 0.
